screens.title: Home (Empty Wallet)
screens.description: Main dashboard with $0 balance, Deposit and Receive action buttons, Earn chip, referral announcement card, and Coins/Collectibles/Activity tabs. Empty token list with 'See what's trending' CTA.
texts: Looking a Little Empty in Here...

screens.title: Deposit
screens.description: Buy/deposit screen with $0 amount display, USDC selected, Debit Card payment method, numpad, $2/Max presets, and Connect to Coinbase CTA at bottom.

screens.title: Token Selector (Deposit)
screens.description: Modal listing tokens available for deposit with search bar and network filter. Shows USDC, Ethereum, cbBTC, Venice Token, EURC, Aerodrome, cbETH, RaveDAO, KAITO with prices and percentage changes.

screens.title: Deposit With Modal
screens.description: Bottom sheet showing payment method option: Connect to Coinbase with description 'Use payment methods on your Coinbase.com account' and Connect arrow.
texts: Use payment methods on your Coinbase.com account

screens.title: Receive
screens.description: Receive tab showing wallet address (0x1c7...b282), Ethereum QR code, supported network badges (Base, Optimism, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Zora), and Copy Wallet Address button.
texts: This address supports all assets on Ethereum, Base, Polygon, and other EVM networks.

screens.title: Scan QR Code
screens.description: Camera viewfinder with QR code scanning frame and text 'Scan a QR code to send crypto'. Part of the Receive/Scan/Request tab group.
texts: Scan a QR code to send crypto

screens.title: Request Payment
screens.description: Request tab with Add Recipient field, $0 amount, USDC token selector, preset amounts ($5/$10/$25), numpad, and 'Enter an amount' swipe CTA.

screens.title: Request From (Add Recipient)
screens.description: Bottom sheet for selecting who to request payment from. Search input with Paste button, QR Code option ('Show your QR code to receive funds'), Tap to Request (proximity), Request via Link (shareable link). Shows 'No recent recipients' empty state.
texts: Show your QR code to receive funds
Search to find someone to send to

screens.title: Network Fee Info (Request)
screens.description: Bottom sheet showing transaction fee details: 'Applies to all transactions and varies based on network usage.' Network: Base. Network fee: Free.
texts: Applies to all transactions and varies based on network usage.

screens.title: Base Rewards Enrollment
screens.description: Earn enrollment screen asking 'Where do you live?' with US and non-US options. 'I don't live in the US' pre-selected with Continue button.
texts: Enroll in Base Rewards to Begin
I don't live in the US

screens.title: Invite Friends to Earn
screens.description: Referral screen showing referral code HDNXPRX6, 'Have your friends use your referral link to earn 25% of their fees', Copy Referral Code and Share Referral Link buttons.
texts: Have your friends use your referral link to earn 25% of their fees. Restrictions apply.

screens.title: Collectibles Tab
screens.description: Collectibles tab on home showing empty state 'Your Collection Awaits' with description about on-chain collectibles.
texts: This is where you can show off all the cool collectibles you find onchain.

screens.title: Activity Tab
screens.description: Activity tab on home showing 'No transactions found' empty state.

screens.title: Discover / Search
screens.description: Search tab with Pinned Apps (Apps, Verify), trending token list with filter chips (Trending/New/Majors/App Coins), watchlist toggle, and search input at bottom.

screens.title: Get Verified
screens.description: WebView at verify.base.dev showing Get Verified landing page with benefits: Earn Rewards, Build Credibility, Boost Visibility. Continue CTA and Terms of Service link.

screens.title: Apps Directory
screens.description: Mini apps directory with featured carousel (RIP.FUN, Beezie, Clash of Coins) and categorized sections: Trading must-haves (Perps by Avantis, Wasabi, Bankr, Aerodrome), Play games (Cat Town), Earn crypto (Morpho, Mamo, Rips), Make predictions (Limitless, Bookie).

screens.title: Token Detail
screens.description: Token detail page (shown for VIRTUAL Protocol) with price ($0.7785), percentage change, market cap ($510M), 24h volume, interactive price chart with 1H/1D/1W/1M/1Y/All periods, candlestick toggle, top holders, external links (Whitepaper, Official website, GeckoTerminal, Dexscreener), contract address, and Buy CTA.

screens.title: Trade / Swap (No Funds)
screens.description: Token swap screen showing USDC → Ethereum. USDC selected with $0.00 balance, 50%/75%/Max preset buttons, $1 entered with '1 Not enough' warning in orange. Flip tokens button, Ethereum output showing 0.00046 ($0.99), exchange rate (1 USDC ≈ 0.00047028 ETH), and 'Add funds' blue CTA.

screens.title: Trading Requires USDC (Trade)
screens.description: Interstitial overlay on Trade screen: 'Trading this coin requires USDC. Add USDC to your wallet to continue with your purchase of ETH.' with Continue button.
texts: Add USDC to your wallet to continue with your purchase of ETH.

screens.title: Deposit Funds (from Trade)
screens.description: Bottom sheet for depositing funds inline from the Trade flow. Shows 'Add funds to your wallet to continue with your purchase.' $2 default amount with USDC, presets ($5/$10/$50), Deposit With Debit Card, Total $2.00, and Connect to Coinbase CTA.
texts: Add funds to your wallet to continue with your purchase.

screens.title: From-Token Selector (Trade)
screens.description: Bottom tray for selecting which token to sell/swap from. Search bar, network filter, token list (USDC, Virtual Protocol, gitlawb, Venice Token, Boon, Aerodrome) all showing $0.00 balance with percentage changes and info icons.

screens.title: To-Token Selector (Trade)
screens.description: Bottom tray for selecting which token to buy/swap into. Search bar, network filter, token list with prices: Ethereum ($2,125), Virtual Protocol ($0.83), gitlawb, Venice Token ($17.80), Boon, Wrapped PROS ($0.61). Each with contract addresses and info icons.

screens.title: Social Feed
screens.description: Live trading feed showing real-time trade broadcast cards. Each card shows avatar, token name, market cap, trade amount, PnL percentage, with Share and Trade action buttons.

screens.title: Notifications
screens.description: Notifications screen with push notification toggle and ETH price alert notifications (up +5.37%, down 4.42%).

screens.title: Notification Settings
screens.description: Notification preferences with push toggle and category rows: Trading, Social, Rewards, Subscriptions, Wallet Activity, Chat, Product Announcements.

screens.title: Profile Drawer
screens.description: Side drawer showing avatar, wallet address (0x1c734aC214...716A50b282), $0 balance, and menu: Invite Friends, View Profile, Settings.

screens.title: View Profile
screens.description: User profile page with Edit Profile and Share Profile buttons, network/category/sort filter chips, Deposit CTA, and Coins/Collectibles/Activity tabs.

screens.title: Edit Profile
screens.description: Edit profile screen with follow button, 'Claim Your Unique Basename Today' card, Display name input, and Bio input.
texts: Tell a little us about yourself...

screens.title: Settings
screens.description: Settings main menu: Display (dark mode, currency, balances), Account management (sign in methods, passcode, biometrics), Connect to Coinbase, Privacy & Security, Trading, Help, Legal. Version 29.95.78, User ID 107426270.

screens.title: Display Settings
screens.description: Display settings with Appearance Mode (Auto - light/dark/match device), App Icon selector, Language (English - US), Local currency (USD).

screens.title: Account Management
screens.description: Account management with Authenticator App (2FA) option and Sign out button.
texts: Use a separate app to generate verification codes.

screens.title: Privacy & Security
screens.description: Privacy settings with Personalized offers toggle, Privacy mode toggle, Payment requests toggle, Decline all requests button, Token Approvals, and Manage Permissions.

screens.title: Trading Settings
screens.description: Trading preferences: Turn on stealth mode toggle (hide trades from social feed), Dust Coins toggle (auto-hide coins under $0.10), Hidden Coins list.
texts: Hide your trades from the social feed.
View coins you've hidden or marked as spam

screens.title: Connect to Coinbase
screens.description: Connect to Coinbase screen with wallet illustration and 'Buy or transfer with Coinbase' CTA. Links to Coinbase User Agreement and Privacy Policy.
texts: You can use your Coinbase account to fund your wallet.

screens.title: Chat
screens.description: Chat home showing 'Chat with AI Agents' section with Bankr ('Your friendly crypto companion') and Elsa ('Turn words into onchain action'). New conversation FAB at bottom right.

screens.title: Global Search
screens.description: Full-screen search overlay with filter chips: All, Coins, Apps, Profiles, Sites. Search input for 'Search Base or URL'.

screens.title: Watchlist (Empty)
screens.description: Watchlist view on Discover tab showing empty state: 'Start your watchlist — Add assets to your watchlist to monitor price moves' with 'View Trending Coins' CTA.
texts: Add assets to your watchlist to monitor price moves

screens.title: Trending Filters
screens.description: Filter tray for trending tokens: Timeframe (5m/1h/4h/12h/24h), Sort by (Trending/Market Cap/Volume/Price Change/Liquidity/Holders/Transactions), Networks (Base/Ethereum/Polygon/Arbitrum/Optimism/Avalanche/BNB Chain), Apply and Reset buttons.

screens.title: Home (Funded)
screens.description: Home dashboard with $1 balance, 4 action buttons (Deposit, Receive, Send, Trade), Earn chip, referral announcement card, Coins/Collectibles/Activity tabs with Network/Category/Sort By filter chips, and USDC row showing 1 USDC = $1.00.

screens.title: Sort By
screens.description: Sort By bottom sheet with direction toggle (High to Low / Low to High) and sort criteria: Balance, Market Cap, Volume, Price Change. Reset and Apply buttons.

screens.title: Network Filter
screens.description: Network filter bottom sheet: All Networks, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Zora, Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Ethereum. Clear and Apply buttons.

screens.title: Category Filter
screens.description: Category filter bottom sheet: Cash, Apps, Memes, Social. Clear and Apply buttons.

screens.title: Activity (Funded)
screens.description: Activity tab showing transaction history. TODAY section with 'Received — From dalxds.base.eth — +$1.00 — 1 USDC' in green.

screens.title: Transaction Detail
screens.description: Received USDC transaction detail: May 26, 2026 1:30 PM. Status: Complete (green checkmark). From: dalxds.base.eth. Amount: 1 USDC. Price: $1.00. Transaction Hash: 0xbc28...6130. Block Explorer link at bottom.

screens.title: Send
screens.description: Send screen with To search input, Paste button, Scan QR code ('Tap to scan an address'), Tap to Send (proximity), Send via Link (shareable), and Recents section ('No recent recipients').
texts: Search to find someone to send to

screens.title: Trade / Swap (Funded)
screens.description: Swap screen with USDC ($1.00 balance) → Ethereum. 50%/75%/Max preset buttons, flip tokens, exchange rate (1 USDC ≈ 0.0004725 ETH), Continue CTA (enabled). When Max is tapped: $1 entered, 'Not enough' (needs gas ETH), shows 'Receive ETH' CTA instead.

screens.title: Trade Max (Needs Gas)
screens.description: Swap with Max tapped: $1 USDC amount, '1 Not enough' warning (needs ETH for gas), Ethereum output 0.00047 ($0.99), exchange rate row, 'Receive ETH' CTA instead of Continue.

screens.title: USDC Token Detail (Owned)
screens.description: USDC token detail showing owned balance: $1.00 (1 USDC) with Send/Receive buttons. About section (Stablecoin badge), description. Stats: Token age 2y, Market cap $76.26B, Total supply 76.28B. Links: Whitepaper, Official website, GeckoTerminal, Dexscreener, contract address 0x8335...2913. Buy and Sell CTAs.

screens.title: Welcome to Base
screens.description: Welcome screen with animated illustration showing trading/DeFi icons. 'Welcome to Base — Trade, send, discover crypto, all in one place.' Apple and Google sign-in icons, Continue with Email CTA, More Options link, Terms and Privacy Policy footer.
texts: Trade, send, discover crypto, all in one place

screens.title: More Options
screens.description: Bottom sheet with three options: Create Account, Import Recovery Phrase, Import Passkey.

screens.title: Email Entry (Onboarding)
screens.description: "What's Your Email? You'll use this to sign in and to recover your account." Email input with placeholder name@email.com, Next button. Shared by both sign-in and create account flows.
texts: You'll use this to sign in and to recover your account.

screens.title: OTP Verification
screens.description: "Let's confirm it's you — Enter the 6-digit code sent to your email." Six digit input boxes, 'Didn't get a code? Resend' with countdown timer, security warning: 'Base will never ask you to set up a new account or transfer funds. Never enter a code given to you by someone else.' Numeric keypad.
texts: Enter the 6-digit code sent to your email
Base will never ask you to set up a new account or transfer funds.

screens.title: Referral Code (New Account Only)
screens.description: "Enter a referral code, if you have one." Referral Code input with Paste button. Incentive: '10% discount on all swap fees — Enter a referral code from a friend and you'll receive a 10% discount on all swap fees.' Skip and Continue buttons. Only shown during new account creation.
texts: Enter a referral code, if you have one.

screens.title: Choose Username (Basename)
screens.description: "Choose username — Choose your unique onchain handle to trade, create, and socialize." Input with name.base.eth placeholder, Personalized Advertising checkbox with info button, Claim CTA.
texts: Choose your unique onchain handle to trade, create, and socialize

screens.title: CAPTCHA Puzzle
screens.description: "Protecting your account — Please solve this puzzle so we know you are a real person." Shield icon, Start Puzzle CTA, session ID, Audio alternative. Overlaid on Choose Username screen.
texts: Please solve this puzzle so we know you are a real person

screens.title: Appearance Mode Picker
screens.description: Bottom sheet with three appearance options: Light, Dark, System. Auto is the default.

screens.title: App Icon Picker
screens.description: Bottom sheet grid of 20 app icon variants: Glass series (Shiny Blue, Blue Gradient, Dark Green, Green, Pink, Pink Blue Gradient — each with flat variant) and Theme series (Blue, Black, Chartreuse, Orange, Indigo, Pink, Purple, Yellow).

screens.title: Language Picker
screens.description: Full-screen language list: English-US (selected), Deutsch, Español (Argentina/España/Latam), Français, हिंदी, 日本語, Italiano, Português (Brazil/Portugal), Pусский, ไทย, Türkçe, 繁體中文.

screens.title: Currency Picker
screens.description: Full-screen currency list with search bar. USD selected. Extensive list: AED, AFN, ALL, AMD, ANG, AOA, ARS, AUD, and many more.

screens.title: Set Up Authenticator
screens.description: Authenticator app 2FA setup: 'Choose an Authenticator App — Use a separate app like Google Authenticator or Authy.' Setup key (ZSQW...YFJL) with copy button. Continue CTA.
texts: Use a separate app like Google Authenticator or Authy.
Copy and enter this setup key into your authenticator app.

screens.title: Sign Out Confirmation
screens.description: Warning screen with red triangle illustration: 'Are you sure you want to sign out? Without access to your wallets, you won't be able to recover the accounts.' Red Sign Out button and Nevermind button.
texts: Are you sure you want to sign out?
Without access to your wallets, you won't be able to recover the accounts.

screens.title: Token Approvals
screens.description: Token approvals management: 'To keep your assets safe, it's a good practice to regularly revoke approvals.' Empty state: 'No active token approvals.'
texts: To keep your assets safe, it's a good practice to regularly revoke approvals

screens.title: Manage Permissions
screens.description: App permissions management. Empty state — no apps have been granted permissions. Shows avatar and close button only.

screens.title: Hidden Coins
screens.description: Hidden coins management with three tabs: Hidden, Spam, Dust. Hidden tab empty: 'Coins you hide will appear here. You can unhide them at any time.'
texts: Coins you hide will appear here. You can unhide them at any time.

screens.title: Help (External)
screens.description: Opens Chrome browser to help.coinbase.com — 'Coinbase Wallet | Coinbase Help'. External website, not in-app.

screens.title: Legal
screens.description: Bottom sheet with two options: Privacy Policy and Terms of Service. Both open external links.
